notes.title: TLC Update v.7!
notes.notes:
The latest update is out as of March 16. Sorry if it took me so long to put it up but I’m glad it finally is. So what’s changed and been added as of version 7? Here’s the rundown.

- Keybinds has been added so you can configure the controls to whatever’s comfortable to you.
- Difficulty Settings Easy, Medium, Hard, Expert has been added back for those who want a little more of a challenge or something a little easy.
- Terrain Destruction has been added so you can go on about destroying the games environments.
- New boss has been added that is exclusive to boss frenzy only. 
- New weapon to be unlocked by completing “Boss Frenzy” on “Normal”.
- New perks added for “Technologist” and “Infiltrator”.
- New Class “Scavenger” has been added. This class can breakdown ammo and combine gunpowder to supply ammo players need or build barricades for defence.
- People who have subbed to the game can change the colours of their weapons in shop.
- Can play and host local servers again.
- Inventory items can now be swapped to different slots.
- Fixed the majority of bugs reported and made many tweaks to the engine that hopefully improves the weird movement latency players were experiencing.

I might have forgotten something but anyways I just want to say a huge thanks to the community for everything. This game would not be here if it weren’t for you guys and the kind encouraging words I hear to keep the game going. \m/

notes.title: Release + Upcoming Updates
notes.notes:
First of all a big thank you to everyone who's tried the game and given some feedback for improvements. Though we had rocky start, I will do my best to try and work on fixing issues that are currently being encountered ASAP. 

Current plans for updates that are high on the list are key bindings, better controls, some tutorial improvements and gameplay improvements. New content will follow after the issues players are facing have been resolved. We will also be introducing more servers, my apologies in advanced for the lack of servers. 

Stay tuned! :)
